changes.description: Fix recursive union validation to require all required structure members to terminate.

Fix `propertiesFrom` and `identifiersFrom` inference in resource lifecycle traits: allow structures that carry both the resource's identifiers and its properties, let `@resourceIdentifier` and `@property` decide a member's kind, honor traits marked `@notProperty`, and type-check every member bound to an identifier or property.
Count resource properties located by resource lifecycle trait bindings as used in `ResourceOperationInputOutput` validation.
Fix quadratic-time container lookup in ModelTransformer.replaceShapes.
Fix exponential time in `TopologicalIndex` on models with many converging paths. Recursive closures are now computed lazily and capped for very large models.
Added a documentation placeholder for Smithy PHP.
Added client guidance for DNS resolution and transport integration.
Updated the bundled Smithy CLI runtime images to include the latest Amazon Corretto 25 fixes.
